title: SRG
description: Symbolic Reasoning Graph structure, defining predicates, aggregators, outcomes, nodes, and edges

predicates.description: Dictionary of predicates keyed by predicate ID

aggregators.description: Dictionary of aggregators keyed by aggregator ID

outcomes.description: Dictionary of outcomes keyed by outcome ID

nodes.description: Dictionary of graph nodes keyed by node ID. MUST contain a Root node with id='Root' and item_id='Root'. Validated programmatically.

edges.description: Dictionary of graph edges keyed by edge ID

policy_context.description: Optional policy context or general guidance applicable to the entire graph

citations.description: Dictionary of citation definitions keyed by citation ID

Root.description: The root node representing the entry point of the graph

Predicate.description: A predicate represents a question or condition to be evaluated

id.description: Unique identifier for the predicate (e.g., 'P1', 'P2', or human-readable like 'is_adult')

question.description: The question or condition text to be evaluated

doc.description: Human-readable documentation providing additional details about the predicate

citation_ids.description: Array of citation IDs referencing source documents or policies

context.description: Optional additional context for evaluating the predicate

metadata.description: Author-defined annotations; not used during evaluation

Outcome.description: An outcome represents a possible result or decision

id.description: Unique identifier for the outcome (e.g., 'O1', 'O2', or human-readable like 'approved')

doc.description: Human-readable documentation providing additional details about the outcome

citation_ids.description: Array of citation IDs referencing source documents or policies

metadata.description: Author-defined annotations; not used during evaluation

Aggregator.description: An aggregator combines multiple predicates or other aggregators using a logical strategy

name.description: Human-readable name for the aggregator (empty string for unnamed aggregators)

truth_value.description: Whether the aggregator uses positive logic (true) or negation (false)

argument_ids.description: IDs of child predicates or aggregators

doc.description: Human-readable documentation providing additional details about the aggregator

citation_ids.description: Array of citation IDs referencing source documents or policies

metadata.description: Author-defined annotations; not used during evaluation

AllStrategy.description: All arguments must evaluate to true

AtLeastStrategy.description: At least N arguments must evaluate to true

count.description: Minimum number of arguments that must be true

AtMostStrategy.description: At most N arguments must evaluate to true

count.description: Maximum number of arguments that can be true

ExactlyStrategy.description: Exactly N arguments must evaluate to true

count.description: Exact number of arguments that must be true

Node.description: A node in the graph that references a symbol (predicate, aggregator, or outcome)

item_id.description: ID of the predicate, aggregator or outcome this node represents; only the node with id 'Root' has item_id 'Root'

Edge.description: A directed edge connecting two nodes in the graph

Citation.description: A citation references a source document or policy with optional bounding boxes and excerpts

source_ref.description: Reference to the source document (e.g., SHA256 hash, file path, or URL)

filename.description: Optional filename of the source document

regions.description: Optional array of regions (bounding boxes) within the document

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt or quote from the source document

metadata.description: Author-defined annotations; not used during evaluation

CitationRegion.description: A region within a document page defined by a bounding box

box.description: Bounding box defined by 4 vertices: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2], [x3, y3], [x4, y4]]
